def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    vals=Counter(v for r in grid for v in r)
    block=vals.most_common(1)[0][0]
    line=[v for v,c in vals.most_common() if v!=block][0]
    hrows=[r for r in range(H) if all(grid[r][c]!=block for c in range(W))]
    vcols=[c for c in range(W) if all(grid[r][c]!=block for r in range(H))]
    M={(r,c):grid[r][c] for r in hrows for c in vcols
       if grid[r][c] not in (block,line)}
    mr=sorted({r for r,_ in M}); mc=sorted({c for _,c in M})
    nR,nC=len(mr)-1,len(mc)-1
    out=[[block]*nC for _ in range(nR)]
    for i in range(nR):

            corners=[(mr[i],mc[j]),(mr[i],mc[j+1]),(mr[i+1],mc[j]),(mr[i+1],mc[j+1])]

# Now apply the transformation
def transform(grid):
    H, W = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    
    vals = Counter(v for r in grid for v in r)
    block = vals.most_common(1)[0][0]
    
    line_v = None
    for v, c in vals.most_common():
        if v != block and line_v is None:
            line_v = v
            break
    
    hrows = [r for r in range(H) if all(grid[r][c] != block for c in range(W))]
    vcols = [c for c in range(W) if all(grid[r][c] != block for r in range(H))]
    
    M = {(r, c): grid[r][c] for r in hrows for c in vcols
         if grid[r][c] not in (block, line_v)}
    
    mr = sorted({r for r, _ in M})
    mc = sorted({c for _, c in M})
    
    nR, nC = len(mr) - 1, len(mc) - 1
    
    out = [[block] * nC for _ in range(nR)]
    
    for i in range(nR):
        for j in range(nC):
            corners = [(mr[i], mc[j]), (mr[i], mc[j+1]), (mr[i+1], mc[j]), (mr[i+1], mc[j+1])]
            cv = [M[k] for k in corners if k in M]
            if len(cv) == 4 and len(set(cv)) == 1:
                out[i][j] = cv[0]
    
    return out

# Apply transformation

def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    vals=Counter(v for r in grid for v in r)
    block=vals.most_common(1)[0][0]
    line=[v for v,c in vals.most_common() if v!=block][0]
    hrows=[r for r in range(H) if all(grid[r][c]!=block for c in range(W))]
    vcols=[c for c in range(W) if all(grid[r][c]!=block for r in range(H))]
    M={(r,c):grid[r][c] for r in hrows for c in vcols
       if grid[r][c] not in (block,line)}
    mr=sorted({r for r,_ in M}); mc=sorted({c for _,c in M})
    nR,nC=len(mr)-1,len(mc)-1
    out=[[block]*nC for _ in range(nR)]
    for i in range(nR):
        for j in range(nC):
            corners=[(mr[i],mc[j]),(mr[i],mc[j+1]),(mr[i+1],mc[j]),(mr[i+1],mc[j+1])]
            cv=[M[k] for k in corners if k in M]
            if len(cv)==4 and len(set(cv))==1: out[i][j]=cv[0]
    return out

    vcols=[c for c in range(W) if all(grid[r][c]!=block for r in range(H))]
    M={(r,c):grid[r][c] for r in hrows for c in vcols
       if grid[r][c] not in (block,line)}
    mr=sorted({r for r,_ in M}); mc=sorted({c for _,c in M})
    nR,nC=len(mr)-1,len(mc)-1

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    H, W = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    vals = Counter(v for r in grid for v in r)
    block = vals.most_common(1)[0][0]
    line_v = [v for v, c in vals.most_common() if v != block][0]
    
    hrows = [r for r in range(H) if all(grid[r][c] != block for c in range(W))]
    vcols = [c for c in range(W) if all(grid[r][c] != block for r in range(H))]
    
    # Build M - intersections where value is not block or line
    M = {}
    for r in hrows:
        for c in vcols:
            val = grid[r][c]
            if val not in (block, line_v):
                M[(r, c)] = val
    
    # Build output grid
    nR = len(hrows) - 1  # 7
    nC = len(vcols) - 1  # 4
    
    out = [[0] * nC for _ in range(nR)]
    
    for r in range(nR):
        for c in range(nC):
            top = (hrows[r], vcols[c])
            bottom = (hrows[r+1], vcols[c])
            left = (hrows[r], vcols[c])
            right = (hrows[r], vcols[c+1])
            
            top_val = M.get(top, 0)
            bottom_val = M.get(bottom, 0)
            left_val = M.get(left, 0)
            right_val = M.get(right, 0)
            
            # Check for uniform corners

            else:

                out[r][c] = block
    
    return out

def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    vals=Counter(v for r in grid for v in r)
    block=vals.most_common(1)[0][0]
    line=[v for v,c in vals.most_common() if v!=block][0]
    hrows=[r for r in range(H) if all(grid[r][c]!=block for c in range(W))]
    vcols=[c for c in range(W) if all(grid[r][c]!=block for r in range(H))]
    M={(r,c):grid[r][c] for r in hrows for c in vcols
       if grid[r][c] not in (block,line)}
    mr=sorted({r for r,_ in M}); mc=sorted({c for _,c in M})
    nR,nC=len(mr)-1,len(mc)-1
    out=[[block]*nC for _ in range(nR)]
    for i in range(nR):
        for j in range(nC):
            corners=[(mr[i],mc[j]),(mr[i],mc[j+1]),(mr[i+1],mc[j]),(mr[i+1],mc[j+1])]
            cv=[M[k] for k in corners if k in M]
